## EXECUTE NOW. WRITE THE FILE. NO PLAN.

Write `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Test/Ecom Design testing/src/data/page-copy.ts`.

## Brand: Vela
- Cognitive nootropic capsules, 60ct/30-day, $79 one-time / $67 subscribe
- Tagline: "Clarity. Every hour."
- Voice: Precise. Assured. Literate. Forbidden: unlock/unleash/maximize/supercharge/boost/elevate/transform/limitless/10x/feel-the-difference/amazing/breakthrough.
- Brand bible: `src/data/brand.md`. Voice bible: `src/data/voice.md`.
- 5 actives: Citicoline 500mg (Cognizin), L-Theanine 200mg, Bacopa Monnieri 300mg (45% bacosides), Lion's Mane 500mg (30% beta-glucan), Rhodiola Rosea 200mg (3% rosavins).

## Mission
Write SHARED below-fold copy used across all 5 variants. Below-fold structure is identical (only above-fold differs per variant). Cover:

### 1. Benefits section (3 benefits, benefit→mechanism→proof pattern)
Each benefit:
- `headline` (5-8 words)
- `body` (1-2 sentences naming mechanism + active responsible)
- `icon` (lucide-react icon name suggestion, e.g., "Brain" / "Timer" / "Activity")

Example shape (DO NOT copy literally):
```
{ headline: "Working memory, encoded.", body: "Citicoline at 500 mg supports phosphatidylcholine synthesis — the substrate behind memory encoding.", icon: "Brain" }
```

### 2. Ingredient stories (5 — one per active)
Each:
- `name` (e.g., "Citicoline (Cognizin)")
- `dosageMg` (number)
- `claim` (1 sentence — what it does, mechanism-anchored)
- `body` (2-3 sentences — why this dose, what study supports it, what it isn't)
- `studyChip` (e.g., "15+ human RCTs", "12-week double-blind RCT", "Open-label safety study")

### 3. Trust stack (4 items)
Order matters per `~/.claude/memory/design/ecom/trust-social-proof-patterns.md`:
- NSF Certified for Sport (badge + 1-line)
- Informed Sport (badge + 1-line)
- 3rd-party tested per batch (badge + 1-line)
- GMP Manufactured (badge + 1-line)

### 4. Reviews (8 reviews — realistic distribution)
Distribution: 5/5/5/5/5/4/4/3 stars. Mix of demographics (operator, athlete, founder, doctor, student, parent, engineer, writer).
Each: `rating` (1-5), `title` (5-8 words), `body` (2-3 sentences SPECIFIC about Day 1 vs Week 8 vs no-jitter), `author` (first name + last initial), `verified` (true), `date` (recent ISO date), `daysOnVela` (number).

### 5. Review summary
- `averageRating: 4.7`
- `totalReviews: 847`
- `distribution: { 5: 524, 4: 203, 3: 76, 2: 25, 1: 19 }` — gives 4.7 avg
- `wouldRecommend: 92` (percent)

### 6. FAQ (8 questions, supplement objections from `~/.claude/memory/content/ecom/objection-handling-library.md`)
Cover: (1) does it actually work, (2) safety + drug interactions, (3) timeframe, (4) caffeine combo OK?, (5) money-back guarantee, (6) cancel subscription anytime?, (7) third-party testing, (8) what's NOT in it.
Each: `question`, `answer` (3-5 sentences, voice-bible compliant).

### 7. CTA blocks (3 distinct copy treatments for end-of-page CTA strip)
- `primary` — straight purchase
- `transparency` — "See the label" angle
- `subscription` — "Subscribe & save" angle
Each: `headline` (5-8 words), `body` (1-2 sentences), `ctaPrimary`, `ctaSecondary`.

### 8. Trust-microcopy (used in cart/checkout reassurance)
- `freeShipping` ("Free shipping on orders over $50")
- `moneyBack` ("60-day money-back. No questions.")
- `cancelAnytime` ("Cancel or pause anytime. No retention emails.")
- `thirdPartyTested` ("Every batch tested by an independent lab.")

### 9. Post-purchase microcopy (1 paragraph)
Confirmation page hero copy + "what to expect Day 1 vs Week 8" snippet.

## Output file format
TypeScript. No `any`. Strong types. Pattern:

```ts
export type Benefit = { headline: string; body: string; icon: string };
export type Ingredient = { name: string; dosageMg: number; claim: string; body: string; studyChip: string };
export type Review = { rating: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5; title: string; body: string; author: string; verified: boolean; date: string; daysOnVela: number };
export type FAQ = { question: string; answer: string };
export type TrustItem = { name: string; description: string; badge: string };
export type CTABlock = { headline: string; body: string; ctaPrimary: string; ctaSecondary: string };

export const pageCopy = {
  benefits: [...] as ReadonlyArray<Benefit>,
  ingredients: [...] as ReadonlyArray<Ingredient>,
  trust: [...] as ReadonlyArray<TrustItem>,
  reviews: [...] as ReadonlyArray<Review>,
  reviewSummary: { ... },
  faq: [...] as ReadonlyArray<FAQ>,
  ctaBlocks: { primary: { ... }, transparency: { ... }, subscription: { ... } },
  trustMicrocopy: { ... },
  postPurchase: "...",
} as const;
```

## Self-checks
- Zero forbidden words
- Reviews feel real (specific Day 1 vs Week 8 detail, no superlatives)
- FAQ answers cite mechanism or number, never vague
- 60-day money-back framing (not 30 — premium category norm)

## After writing
Reply with the 8 review titles + 8 FAQ questions inline. Under 250 words.

22	### Voice DNA (META-002)
23	
24	**IS: confident, precise, founder-direct**
25	- **Confident** = assert opinions. State decisions, not options. "We do X" not "Some teams might consider X."
26	- **Precise** = specific numbers + named patterns. "40% lift vs Allbirds baseline" not "significant improvement."
27	- **Founder-direct** = sounds like Yash shipping. Active voice, short sentences, no padding.

29	**IS NOT: salesy, hedged, agency-corporate**
30	- **Salesy** = marketing-speak ("transform your business", "unlock value"). Auto-reject.
31	- **Hedged** = "depending on...", "usually", "often" without specifying conditions. Auto-reject.
32	- **Agency-corporate** = deck-template language ("Phase 1: Discovery", "Our process is..."). Auto-reject.

34	### Anti-Signals — Grep-Detectable Quality Failures (META-003)
35	
36	**Three auto-reject patterns:**
37	
38	1. **Banned words list** — auto-reject any output containing:
39	   - `leverage` · `synergy` · `innovative` · `seamless` · `robust` · `cutting-edge` · `next-gen` · `best-in-class`
40	   - Detection: `grep -wE 'leverage|synergy|innovative|seamless|robust|cutting-edge|next-gen|best-in-class'`
